notes.title: Measures against disruptive behavior, cheating, and use of unauthorized tools
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing DEATH NOTE Killer Within.[/h3]

We are committed to ensuring a fair and enjoyable gameplay experience for all players. 
As such, any actions that disrupt fair play, including cheating, the use of unauthorized tools, and other inappropriate behavior, are strictly prohibited. We will actively investigate such cases based on player feedback and in-game logs.
In accordance with Article 12 of our End User License Agreement (EULA), accounts found engaging in the above violations will receive warnings based on logged data. 
If no improvement is observed, we may impose penalties including temporary suspensions on the offending accounts.
Additionally, behavior that obstructs fair gameplay like repeatedly disconnecting during active matches or harrassing other players will also be subject to similar actions.
Please note that if a player fails to correct their behavior even after warnings or suspensions, we may enforce a permanent ban on their account.

We will continue to proactively use data logs to monitor and respond to misconduct. If you encounter players engaging in disruptive or unfair behavior, we kindly ask that you report them using the in-game reporting feature.

■ In-Game Reporting Feature
From the main menu: Press the R2 button or the 4 key to open the Friends Menu. From the relevant tab, select the user you wish to report, click the Report button, and choose the reason for reporting. Players you recently played with can be found under the Recently Played With tab.
From the Room screen: Open the Player List, select the offending user, click the Report button, and choose the reason for reporting.
We are committed to providing a fair and enjoyable playing experience for all users, and to this end we will apply appropriate penalties to players who engage in disruptive or unfair behavior.

Thank you again for your continued support of DEATH NOTE Killer Within.

notes.title: Measures against interruption of gameplay due to disconnections
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you for playing [b]DEATH NOTE Killer Within[/b].[/h3]

If a player other than the host, “Kira”, “Kira Follower”, or “L” leaves the room in the action phase or meeting phase due to disconnection or other reasons, the game will not be interrupted.

[b]▼Action Phase[/b]
If a living player other than the host, “Kira,” “Kira Follower,” or “L” disconnects, their avatar will not remain in the stage.
Disconnection during death will be treated the same as when a spectator leaves the room, and the player's corpse and dying message will remain in the stage.

[b]▼Meeting Phase[/b]
Players who disconnect without voting will be forced to skip voting.
L cannot choose to confiscate items from players who disconnect after the vote.

*Please note that players who disconnect intentionally or multiple times will be subject to warnings and bans. You can see the details [url=https://www.bandainamcoent.asia/sea/news/death-note-killer-within-disconnection-issues-patch]here[/url].

[h3]We look forward to your continued support for [b]DEATH NOTE Killer Within[/b].[/h3]

notes.title: Measures against disruptive behavior, cheating, and use of unauthorized tools
notes.content:
Thank you for playing "DEATH NOTE Killer Within".

Based on player feedback and recorded logs, we have identified players who are intentionally disconnecting from the game and interrupting play. We view this as a problem that interferes with other players' gameplay, and we are considering ways to improve the situation.

In DEATH NOTE Killer Within, we prohibit any actions that interfere with fair gameplay, as well as any use of unauthorized tools or other forbidden activities.
In accordance with Article 12 of the End User License Agreement (EULA), if we confirm that a player has engaged in any of the above mentioned activities, we will send a warning to the player in question. If there is still no improvement, we will take further measures such as suspending the account.
The same will also apply in the case of repeated disconnections during online play or other annoying behavior that causes trouble for other players.

We will investigate and take action based on the logs we have obtained, but if you see a player who is engaging in disruptive behavior, cheating, or using unauthorized tools, please report them using the in-game reporting function or contact the local subsidiary of the distributor, Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.

Please note that we cannot promise to immediately respond to all reports received.

▼In-game reporting function
- On the main menu, press the "R2" button or "4" to display the "Friends Menu", select the relevant user from each tab, press the "Report" button, select the reason, and report. You can see the players you have played with recently in the "Recently Played With" tab.

- In the room, select the relevant user from the "Player List", press the "Report" button, select the reason, and report.

We will continue to work to apply penalties to players who cause trouble or behave inappropriately, for the benefit of all players who enjoy fair gameplay.
We look forward to your continued support for "DEATH NOTE Killer Within".

notes.title: DEATH NOTE KILLER WITHIN COMING ON NOVEMBER 5th
notes.content:
[h2]DEATH NOTE Killer Within, the first-ever social deduction game based on the legendary anime series,  will be available on November 5th ![/h2]

[previewyoutube=qJ9ekWop694;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]DEATH NOTE Killer Within is an online social deduction game with cross-play support, where up to 10 players face a choice between life and death. Split into 2 teams, players must uncover each other’s identities to eliminate L or seize the Death Note from Kira. Kira and L are equally matched, each hiding their true identity while battling for control over the game. 

In DEATH NOTE Killer Within, players can assume one of four roles - Kira, Kira Follower, L, or Investigator - each offering unique gameplay characteristics. With each assigned role, players can develop a wide range of strategies, as randomized scenarios evolve into high-stakes games. 

Additionally, players can customize their nameplates, in-game avatars with up to seven types of accessories, and special effects displayed during key gameplay moments. [/h3]
